t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Cold colours show the yellow basket and warm colours show the red basket. Keep picking the corresponding colours until the mushroom piles decrease - then switch.

vb_textbox.text: The cold colour gnomes such as blue and yellow will lead you to the yellow basket. The warm colour gnomes such as red and orange will lead you to the red basket. Select one basket colour until the mushrooms reduce in quantity. However, use the x1 multiplier to scout for any changes in the mushroom quantity between the baskets. This will then lead to more correct answers in the bigger x5 multipliers.
